en: Fetch arrows in the archery range south of the New Avalon town square. You may also acquire arrows when fighting rangers.

Whoa! Awfully brave to be stomping around the shooting grounds amidst our training. You're practically begging for a projectile to the knee, or maybe your behind given the way you're shuffling around.

But hey, your safety is your prerogative. Since you seem like a real risk taker, why not lend us a helping hand? Gathering our arrows after every round of shots takes away from precious shooting time.

How about you go grab a few for me, eh?

Fizzlefuse in New Avalon has requested a quill and something to make his hideout more comfortable. A Classy Quill can be found in the New Avalon Town Hall, and a House Prop may be found somewhere near Scholomance or in the Karazhan Crypts.

I am not the type of goblin to share his secrets with some random adventurer, but I AM the type to share a gnome's! I happened to procure a few schematics on my way out here and am working on correcting the shortcomings in their designs. They still use safety fuses! Can you believe that? SAFETY FUSES!!

Anyway, I am eager to share my progress, but I need a quill if I am going to scribble out all this junk. And I could use a cozy space so I can do some thinking. What do you say?
